string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_tile_size
string-array.item: Changes the size of app tiles and how many fit on a desktop page.

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_columns
string-array.item: Sets the number of app columns. Automatic adapts to the available width.

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_icon_style
string-array.item: Changes the shape and treatment of app icons in the grid.

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_show_labels
string-array.item: Shows or hides app names below the icons on the desktop.

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_sort_order
string-array.item: Changes the order of the All apps grid. Manual order follows the sequence you save.

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_edit_manual_order
string-array.item: Reorder apps in All apps when Manual sorting is selected.

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_shortcuts
string-array.item: Choose which built-in Controls shortcuts appear in the app grid.

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_hidden_apps
string-array.item: Choose which apps appear in All apps. Hidden apps can still open from their Favorites shortcuts.

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_show_search_field
string-array.item: Keeps the search field above All apps. The keyboard opens when you tap the field.

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_hide_by_default
string-array.item: Applies the default filter for firmware and service apps. Your individual visibility choices take priority.

string-array.name: guide_apps_desktop_enable
string-array.item: Adds Favorites desktops alongside All apps so you can keep separate sets of shortcuts.

string-array.name: guide_apps_desktop_default
string-array.item: Chooses the desktop that the app grid opens by default.

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_desktop_names
string-array.item: Renames desktop tabs. Each desktop keeps its own name.

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_favorites_back
string-array.item: Chooses where Android Back takes you from a Favorites desktop.

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_smooth_paging
string-array.item: Controls the transition between desktop pages when you swipe or select a page.

string-array.name: guide_apps_wallpaper_title
string-array.item: Choose a wallpaper for each desktop. Restoring the default affects the selected desktop.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_layouts_settings
string-array.item: Save a snapshot of the desktop arrangement and apply it later from Settings or a routine.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_layouts_name
string-array.item: Names the saved layout in the picker and routine editor.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_settings
string-array.item: Choose which information cards each desktop shows and how much width they take.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_desktop
string-array.item: Selects the desktop whose cards you are editing.

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_card_placement
string-array.item: Chooses whether information cards or pinned apps appear first on a Favorites desktop.

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_card_outlines
string-array.item: Adds a visible outline to desktop information cards so their boundaries are easier to see.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_clock_format
string-array.item: Sets whether the clock card uses the system format, 12-hour time or 24-hour time.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_media_style
string-array.item: Changes how track information and playback controls are arranged on the media card.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_media_open_target
string-array.item: Chooses what tapping the media card opens, or makes the card display-only.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_media_source
string-array.item: Selects the player that supplies track information to the desktop card.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_headlights_content
string-array.item: Chooses which headlight reading the desktop card shows.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_phone_edit
string-array.item: Choose and order up to three saved voice contacts. A card button opens the dialer with the number filled in.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_route_content
string-array.item: Selects whether the navigation card shows the next turn only or also the current road.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_route_open_target
string-array.item: Chooses what tapping the navigation card opens, or makes the card display-only.

string-array.name: guide_home_navigator_card
string-array.item: Puts the Yandex Navigator widget on the supported factory home screen in place of the Baidu map.

string-array.name: guide_home_navigator_widget_scale
string-array.item: Changes the scale of the map and controls. The widget keeps its place on the factory home screen.

string-array.name: guide_home_weather_card
string-array.item: Shows weather on the supported factory home screen.

string-array.name: guide_home_media_card_apps
string-array.item: Adds Voyah Music and Voyah Radio, when installed, to the sources of the factory home screen’s media card.

string-array.name: guide_home_media_card_hide_online
string-array.item: Removes the Chinese online services, which do not work outside China, from the factory home screen’s media card. Bluetooth and USB music stay.

string-array.name: guide_home_cluster_card_apps
string-array.item: Lets the factory media card on the instrument cluster show Voyah Music and Voyah Radio, when installed, while they play.

string-array.name: guide_driver_media_layout
string-array.item: Shows larger artwork, the track or station, and available playback progress in the left media area. Enable Voyah Music and Voyah Radio on the instrument cluster first.

string-array.name: guide_driver_navigation_card
string-array.item: With Navigation feed enabled, live route guidance appears in the left media area. The media view returns when guidance ends or stops updating.

string-array.name: guide_driver_navigator_window
string-array.item: Open the full Yandex Navigator window in the left media area. Restore media card closes the window and brings back the usual view.

string-array.name: guide_driver_navigator_restore
string-array.item: Close the full Navigator window and restore the usual media view in the left area.

string-array.name: guide_home_weather_city
string-array.item: Sets the city used by the factory home screen’s weather card.

string-array.name: guide_apps_hide
string-array.item: Removes this app from All apps and its search. Existing Favorites shortcuts can still open it.

string-array.name: guide_app_icon_plain
string-array.item: Attempts to remove the white background around this app’s icon. The result depends on the source picture.

string-array.name: guide_window_hook_title
string-array.item: Enables the supported window service used for opening apps with custom window and display settings.

string-array.name: guide_window_strip_title
string-array.item: Lets Android reserve a strip beside app windows for the factory launcher panel on supported firmware.

string-array.name: guide_app_window_panel_width
string-array.item: Sets the minimum space kept beside this app for the factory panel. Automatic uses the detected width.

string-array.name: guide_app_window_width
string-array.item: Sets how much of the available window area this app uses on supported displays.

string-array.name: guide_app_window_dpi
string-array.item: Sets the display density for this app when the window service opens it. Higher DPI makes the app’s interface larger.

string-array.name: guide_app_display_defaults_title
string-array.item: Sets default app density separately for each display. Per-app DPI can override it.
Default DPI for apps on this display

string-array.name: guide_window_swipe_title
string-array.item: Configure a multi-finger swipe that moves the active app between supported displays.

string-array.name: guide_window_swipe_fingers
string-array.item: Select two or three fingers for moving windows between displays, or switch the gesture off.

string-array.name: guide_window_swipe_after
string-array.item: Chooses what remains on the source display after you move a window away.

string-array.name: guide_display_density
string-array.item: Sets DPI for the virtual display rather than the physical screens.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_show_media
string-array.item: Shows the active media pane in the virtual display preview.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_show_navigation
string-array.item: Shows the route pane in the virtual display preview when route information is available.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_show_playback_progress
string-array.item: Adds the current playback position and track duration to the media pane.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_show_album_artwork
string-array.item: Shows available cover art in the media pane.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_show_transport_controls
string-array.item: Shows playback buttons that the active player supports.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_arrangement
string-array.item: Places the media and route panes next to each other or one above the other.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_pane_order
string-array.item: Selects which pane comes first when both media and navigation are visible.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_media_source
string-array.item: Chooses the app that supplies media data, or follows the current active player.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_media_fallback
string-array.item: Chooses whether the preview may use another active player when the preferred one has no session.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_seek_step
string-array.item: Sets how far the skip-back and skip-forward buttons move the track when seeking is supported.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_details
string-array.item: Opens the controls for preview layout, road labels, text and colors.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_text_size
string-array.item: Changes text size inside the virtual display preview.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_palette
string-array.item: Selects the color scheme of the virtual display preview independently of the main app.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_pane_balance
string-array.item: Changes how available width is split between media and route in side-by-side mode.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_hide_empty_panes
string-array.item: Releases space reserved for a media or route pane while that pane has no data.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_media_subtitle
string-array.item: Chooses what extra track information appears below the title.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_show_current_road
string-array.item: Shows the current road name in the route pane when provided by navigation.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_show_next_road
string-array.item: Adds the road name after the next maneuver when navigation provides it.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_road_names
string-array.item: Chooses how names provided by navigation are written, including transliteration where available.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_show_turn_distance
string-array.item: Adds the distance remaining to the next maneuver when the route feed has it.

string-array.name: guide_display_preview_distance_units
string-array.item: Sets the units used for the distance to a turn.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_palette
string-array.item: Changes the colors of Controls surfaces and text. Choose a dark palette or daytime colors.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_accent
string-array.item: Changes the color used for actions, selections, focus and the startup intro.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_background
string-array.item: Chooses a subtle ambient backdrop or a flat surface behind Controls pages.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_high_contrast
string-array.item: Makes text, outlines and selection states stand out more against the background.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_text_size
string-array.item: Changes the base size of Controls text and labels. Titles and navigation labels can use their own settings.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_navigation_label_size
string-array.item: Changes navigation labels separately or makes them follow the general text size.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_page_title_size
string-array.item: Changes page headings separately from regular text when you choose a fixed size.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_font_family
string-array.item: Selects the typeface Controls uses for its interface.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_bold_text
string-array.item: Makes Controls text heavier for easier reading.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_spacing
string-array.item: Changes gaps and padding across the Controls interface.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_corners
string-array.item: Changes the radius of cards, buttons and dialogs in Controls.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_animate_routes
string-array.item: Enables short animations when moving between Controls screens.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_transition_speed
string-array.item: Changes how quickly page transitions finish when screen animations are enabled.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_wallpaper_dimming
string-array.item: Changes how much custom desktop wallpapers are darkened behind icons and cards.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_start_screen
string-array.item: Chooses where the Open Controls launcher shortcut goes.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_limit_media_on_launch
string-array.item: Can lower media that is already above the selected cap when Controls launches. Quieter media stays at its current level.

string-array.name: guide_appearance_launch_media_limit
string-array.item: Sets the upper media volume allowed by the launch limit.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_enabled
string-array.item: Shows a bar of Controls and app shortcuts inside the Controls window.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_area
string-array.item: Chooses on which Controls screens the quick-action bar appears.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_hide_on_virtual_display
string-array.item: Gives the virtual display page and its preview the full available Controls window.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_headlight_indicator
string-array.item: Adds the last known or live headlight reading to the expanded bar.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_headlight_content
string-array.item: Selects what the bar’s light indicator shows: switch mode, headlamps or high beam.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_headlight_tap
string-array.item: Selects what tapping the headlight indicator opens.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_apps_destination
string-array.item: Chooses whether the Apps shortcut opens your default desktop or the All apps grid.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_side
string-array.item: Places the side bar on the left or right of wide screens.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_wide_width
string-array.item: Sets the width the side bar reserves on wide screens.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_rail_alignment
string-array.item: Moves the expanded shortcuts to the top, center or bottom of the side bar.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_compact_edge
string-array.item: Moves the bar between the top and bottom edges on compact screens.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_labels
string-array.item: Adds names below or beside shortcut icons. Compact screens can override this choice.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_compact_labels
string-array.item: Overrides shortcut labels on compact screens or follows the main labels setting.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_start_state
string-array.item: Chooses whether the bar is open when Controls starts. Default follows Collapse after choosing a shortcut.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_collapse_after_use
string-array.item: Folds the bar after you tap a shortcut.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_idle_collapse
string-array.item: Folds the open bar after the selected time without interaction.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_keep_side_inset
string-array.item: Keeps the same page width after a wide side bar collapses, so content stays in place.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_handle_size
string-array.item: Changes the size of the button used to expand the collapsed bar.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_side_handle_position
string-array.item: Places the expand button at the top, center or bottom of the collapsed side bar on wide screens.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_compact_handle_side
string-array.item: Moves the expand button to the left or right on a compact screen.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_handle_accent
string-array.item: Sets the expand button’s accent to the app theme, amber or teal.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_dim_idle_handle
string-array.item: Softens the expand button’s fill while idle. Touch or focus brings back the full color.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_contrast_handle
string-array.item: Makes the expand button’s arrow and border more distinct.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_compact_handle_label
string-array.item: Shows a text caption beside the collapsed button on compact screens.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_larger_shortcuts
string-array.item: Gives selected built-in shortcuts bigger tap targets on the expanded bar.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_routine_shortcut
string-array.item: Runs the chosen saved routine from the bar in one tap.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_shortcuts
string-array.item: Choose which Controls shortcuts appear on the bar and change their order.

string-array.name: guide_ui_69
string-array.item: Applies your assignments to supported buttons in the factory launcher panel.

string-array.name: guide_ui_43
string-array.item: Enables the actions you assigned to captured Android hardware buttons.

string-array.name: guide_oem_short
string-array.item: Chooses the action for a short press of this button.

string-array.name: guide_oem_hold
string-array.item: Chooses the action for holding this button past the hold threshold.

string-array.name: guide_ui_98
string-array.item: Applies this Android key binding on all input devices with the same key code.

string-array.name: guide_ui_99
string-array.item: Enables this individual assignment while keeping the chosen actions saved.

string-array.name: guide_ui_91
string-array.item: Selects which Android key code this assignment listens for.
Matching key code triggers the binding

string-array.name: guide_ui_95
string-array.item: Names this assignment in the hardware button list.

string-array.name: guide_ui_115
string-array.item: Sets how long a button must be held to trigger its hold action.

string-array.name: guide_ui_116
string-array.item: Sets the debounce interval used to ignore very closely spaced repeated presses.

string-array.name: guide_cockpit_language
string-array.item: Changes the language of Controls menus and settings. Voice recognition has its own language setting.

string-array.name: guide_keyboard_choice_section
string-array.item: Selects the keyboard for the supported displays or restores the factory keyboard.

string-array.name: guide_text_overlays_title
string-array.item: Installs a supported language pack for factory apps on matching firmware. Individual apps can be opted out.

string-array.name: guide_text_overlays_off
string-array.item: Restores the original factory app text on supported apps.

string-array.name: guide_cockpit_dictionary_russian
string-array.item: Uses the bundled Russian text dictionary where factory screen translation is supported.

string-array.name: guide_translation_import
string-array.item: Loads a compatible custom translation dictionary for supported factory screens.

string-array.name: guide_updates_startup_toggle
string-array.item: Looks for a compatible newer Controls release in the background at startup. Manual checking remains available.

string-array.name: guide_settings_archive_export
string-array.item: Saves portable Controls settings in a file you can keep or move to another installation.

string-array.name: guide_settings_archive_import
string-array.item: Reviews and restores portable choices from a compatible Controls backup.

string-array.name: guide_headlight_monitoring_open
string-array.item: Listens for supported headlight feedback while Controls is open. It updates the reading in Vehicle and enabled cards.

string-array.name: guide_seat_memory_open_factory_on_tap
string-array.item: Opens factory Seats when you choose Save or Restore in Controls. The factory screen handles the actual seat positions.

string-array.name: guide_service_reminder_show_on_vehicle
string-array.item: Shows your maintenance plan and its current due status on the Vehicle page.

string-array.name: guide_service_reminder_interval
string-array.item: Sets the distance between services. Controls adds it to the last service odometer value.
Next service at the selected distance

string-array.name: guide_service_reminder_current
string-array.item: Provides the current odometer value for the distance remaining calculation.

string-array.name: guide_service_reminder_last
string-array.item: Records the odometer value at the most recent service, which anchors the distance plan.

string-array.name: guide_service_reminder_lead_title
string-array.item: Sets how far before the due mileage Controls starts showing an early reminder.

string-array.name: guide_service_reminder_calendar_interval
string-array.item: Adds the selected number of months to the last service date to calculate the next due date.

string-array.name: guide_service_reminder_calendar_lead_title
string-array.item: Sets how many days before the due date the calendar reminder becomes active.

string-array.name: guide_vehicle_automation_lights_enabled
string-array.item: Enables the configured headlight routine on supported firmware when the gear changes and its checks pass.

string-array.name: guide_vehicle_automation_on_drive
string-array.item: Chooses the lighting action the routine requests on shifting into Drive, when the feature and vehicle checks allow it.

string-array.name: guide_vehicle_automation_on_park
string-array.item: Chooses the lighting action the routine requests on reaching Park, when the vehicle checks allow it.

string-array.name: guide_vehicle_automation_memory_enabled
string-array.item: Remembers the last observed driving mode and can restore it when the supported start conditions are met.

string-array.name: guide_voice_recognition
string-array.item: Open the recognition language, offline engine and online interpretation settings.

string-array.name: guide_voice_language
string-array.item: Selects the language of both the phrases in this catalog and the offline recognition model.

string-array.name: guide_voice_recognition_engine
string-array.item: Selects the offline speech engine. Zipformer is available for Russian on supported devices. Vosk is available for all supported voice languages.

string-array.name: guide_voice_online_title
string-array.item: Allows optional online interpretation of a confident local transcript when no catalog phrase matches.
Online service may suggest a supported command

string-array.name: guide_voice_online_switch
string-array.item: Enables the OpenRouter fallback for supported intents. The service receives short recognized text.
Text fallback after a missed command

string-array.name: guide_voice_online_key
string-array.item: Stores the key used to connect to your OpenRouter account on this device.

string-array.name: guide_default_levels
string-array.item: Sets saved seat comfort levels used when a voice command asks to enable the feature without naming a level.

string-array.name: guide_window_options
string-array.item: Choose how much the windows open for the Smoke and Ventilation commands on supported vehicles.

string-array.name: guide_double_smoke
string-array.item: Uses the extended driver-window position for the Smoke command.

string-array.name: guide_double_ventilation
string-array.item: Uses extended window gaps for the cabin Ventilation command.

string-array.name: guide_voice_vehicle_commands
string-array.item: Choose which vehicle commands may be requested. Firmware and vehicle-state checks still apply.
Command allowed to reach its checks

string-array.name: guide_voice_audio_settings
string-array.item: Adjust voice feedback, listening signals and how long the voice popup stays visible.

string-array.name: guide_voice_spoken_feedback
string-array.item: Plays a spoken reply after a recognized voice command using an installed offline voice.

string-array.name: guide_voice_speech_rate
string-array.item: Changes how quickly spoken replies and voice samples are read.

string-array.name: guide_voice_speech_volume
string-array.item: Changes the level of spoken replies relative to the selected audio channel.

string-array.name: guide_voice_feedback_style
string-array.item: Chooses whether the reply repeats what was recognized or reads the outcome.

string-array.name: guide_voice_reply_channel
string-array.item: Sends spoken feedback and samples to the Assistant or Media audio channel.

string-array.name: guide_voice_offline_voice
string-array.item: Selects an installed voice for replies in the current recognition language. Automatic finds a compatible voice.

string-array.name: guide_voice_ready_cue
string-array.item: Plays a ready signal before each recording starts.

string-array.name: guide_voice_ready_style
string-array.item: Selects a tone or a spoken prompt as the ready signal.

string-array.name: guide_voice_ready_phrase
string-array.item: Sets a custom ready phrase for this recognition language. Clear it to use the built-in prompt.

string-array.name: guide_voice_ready_cue_volume
string-array.item: Controls how loud the ready signal plays before listening.

string-array.name: guide_voice_end_listening_cue
string-array.item: Chooses the sound played when the microphone closes or turns it off.

string-array.name: guide_voice_end_cue_volume
string-array.item: Changes only the end-of-listening sound level. The reset button restores the sound’s preset.

string-array.name: guide_voice_capture_popup
string-array.item: Open settings for the listening deadline, result time and recognized text on the voice popup.

string-array.name: guide_voice_listening_limit
string-array.item: Sets the longest time the microphone can listen for one command.

string-array.name: guide_voice_result_duration
string-array.item: Sets how long the voice popup holds the result. Spoken feedback can keep it visible a little longer.

string-array.name: guide_voice_show_recognized_phrase
string-array.item: Shows the exact recognized phrase above the result when one is available.

string-array.name: guide_voice_startup_volume
string-array.item: Applies your chosen media level once when the head unit starts.

string-array.name: guide_voice_startup_volume_level
string-array.item: Sets the share of maximum media volume to use at head unit startup.

string-array.name: guide_voice_duck_media
string-array.item: Temporarily lowers media while the voice microphone is listening.

string-array.name: guide_voice_duck_calls
string-array.item: Temporarily lowers media during calls reported by the head unit.

string-array.name: guide_voice_duck_level
string-array.item: Sets how much of the current media volume remains while ducking is active.

string-array.name: guide_ui_177
string-array.item: Manage contacts and backups for voice settings and restore a working configuration.
Saved settings or restored voice setup

string-array.name: guide_ui_181
string-array.item: Adds a contact for offline voice dialing. The command opens Android’s dialer with the saved number.

string-array.name: guide_ui_193
string-array.item: Use a clear name that you can pronounce when asking Controls to call this contact.

string-array.name: guide_ui_194
string-array.item: Sets the number filled into Android’s dialer when the contact command is recognized.

string-array.name: guide_routines_name
string-array.item: Names the routine wherever it can be selected or launched.

string-array.name: guide_routines_page
string-array.item: Chooses which Controls page the routine opens.

string-array.name: guide_routines_layout
string-array.item: Optionally applies a saved desktop layout when the routine runs.

string-array.name: guide_routines_theme
string-array.item: Optionally changes the Controls palette when the routine runs.

string-array.name: guide_routines_app
string-array.item: Optionally opens a chosen installed app as part of the routine.

string-array.name: guide_routines_pin
string-array.item: Keeps this routine in the pinned group for easier access.

string-array.name: guide_routines_startup_enabled
string-array.item: Runs the selected startup routine according to its schedule when launched from the launcher.

string-array.name: guide_routines_days
string-array.item: Choose on which days the launcher startup routine may run.

string-array.name: guide_routines_frequency
string-array.item: Sets how often an eligible launcher startup can run the routine.

string-array.name: guide_routines_delay
string-array.item: Waits the selected interval after opening from the launcher before running the routine.

string-array.name: guide_routines_limit_hours
string-array.item: Restricts startup routine launches to the selected time window.

string-array.name: guide_routines_time_start
string-array.item: Sets when the daily window for the startup routine begins.
Routine eligible from the start time

string-array.name: guide_routines_time_end
string-array.item: Sets when the daily window for the startup routine ends.
Routine held until the next window

string-array.name: guide_rules_enabled
string-array.item: Checks this rule when supported vehicle observations change and runs its routine when the conditions are met.

string-array.name: guide_rules_gear
string-array.item: Requires the selected gear for the rule to match. Any gear removes this condition.

string-array.name: guide_rules_doors
string-array.item: Requires the chosen door condition for the rule to match. Choose Any to ignore doors.

string-array.name: guide_rules_routine
string-array.item: Chooses the saved routine that runs when this rule matches.

string-array.name: guide_rules_cooldown
string-array.item: Sets the minimum time between runs of this rule.
Can run again after the interval

string-array.name: guide_seasonal_climate_enabled
string-array.item: Makes the seasonal preset available when its conditions match and vehicle checks allow it.

string-array.name: guide_seasonal_climate_above_field
string-array.item: Sets the outdoor temperature above which the summer preset can be applied.

string-array.name: guide_seasonal_climate_below_field
string-array.item: Sets the outdoor temperature below which the winter preset can be applied.

string-array.name: guide_seasonal_climate_gear
string-array.item: Requires Park or Drive before applying this preset, according to your choice and the vehicle checks.

string-array.name: guide_seasonal_climate_closed_doors
string-array.item: Requires all doors to be reported closed before applying the seasonal preset.

string-array.name: guide_seasonal_climate_driver
string-array.item: Sets the requested temperature for the driver’s climate zone when the preset is applied.

string-array.name: guide_seasonal_climate_passenger
string-array.item: Sets the requested temperature for the front passenger’s zone when the preset is applied.

string-array.name: guide_seasonal_climate_fan
string-array.item: Sets the requested fan speed for this seasonal preset.

string-array.name: guide_seasonal_climate_driver_seat
string-array.item: Requests driver seat ventilation in summer or heating in winter. Unchanged leaves its level as is.
Driver seat level from the preset

string-array.name: guide_seasonal_climate_passenger_seat
string-array.item: Requests passenger seat ventilation in summer or heating in winter. Unchanged leaves its level as is.
Passenger seat level from the preset

string-array.name: guide_action_permissions_title
string-array.item: Choose whether each listed action is allowed, recorded as unverified, or blocked before dispatch.
Request permitted under its usual checks

string-array.name: guide_apps_grid_reorder_pins
string-array.item: Choose and reorder app shortcuts for this Favorites desktop. Each desktop keeps its own pins.

string-array.name: guide_app_picker_show_all
string-array.item: Temporarily includes hidden, factory and service apps in this picker.

string-array.name: guide_app_icon_title
string-array.item: A custom image replaces this app’s icon in Controls. Reset brings back the launcher icon.
Your image in the app grid

string-array.name: guide_apps_permissions
string-array.item: Grants or revokes the shown Android permission for this app. Options depend on the installed app and Android version.

string-array.name: guide_quick_actions_app_shortcuts
string-array.item: Adds installed apps after the Controls shortcuts. You can set their order or remove them later.

string-array.name: guide_rules_name
string-array.item: Names this rule in the If–then rules list.

string-array.name: guide_service_reminder_calendar_last_date
string-array.item: Sets the date from which the calendar service interval is counted.

string-array.name: guide_routines_startup
string-array.item: Selects the routine that can run from the launcher when the startup schedule permits it.

string-array.name: guide_routines_sort
string-array.item: Sorts the saved routine library by name or by newest first.

string-array.name: guide_text_overlays_apps_heading
string-array.item: Keeps or removes translation for the selected factory app without changing the choice for other apps.

string-array.name: guide_firmware_translation_heading
string-array.item: Choose the language or dictionary used for supported factory screen text. Disable it to restore the factory labels.

string-array.name: guide_oem_steering
string-array.item: Assigns actions to supported steering wheel presses. Each listed gesture can have a different action.
Action assigned to a steering gesture

string-array.name: guide_ui_67
string-array.item: Assigns apps and actions to the supported factory panel buttons. A button without an assignment keeps its factory action.

string-array.name: guide_ui_44
string-array.item: Create or edit a binding for a captured Android key. Assign separate actions for a tap and a hold.

string-array.name: guide_display_media_access
string-array.item: Lets Controls read the active media session for track information and compatible playback or rating controls.

string-array.name: guide_home_navigator_widget_settings
string-array.item: Opens Yandex Navigator widget controls for the map theme and zoom.

string-array.name: guide_display_navigation
string-array.item: Allows a compatible navigator to pass live turn guidance to Controls. Availability depends on this unit.

string-array.name: guide_passenger_workspace_title
string-array.item: Opens a separate launcher on a supported passenger display.
Workspace opens on the passenger display

string-array.name: guide_passenger_workspace_compact
string-array.item: Uses smaller app tiles in the passenger workspace.

string-array.name: guide_passenger_workspace_clock
string-array.item: Shows the current time in the passenger workspace.

string-array.name: guide_passenger_workspace_date
string-array.item: Adds the current date beside the time in the passenger workspace.

string-array.name: guide_passenger_workspace_startup
string-array.item: Opens the passenger workspace automatically when Controls starts and the display is available.

string-array.name: guide_passenger_workspace_app_slot
string-array.item: Chooses the app opened by this workspace tile. Select an empty slot to remove its shortcut.

string-array.name: guide_passenger_workspace_dock_slot
string-array.item: Chooses the app opened by this shortcut in the passenger dock.

string-array.name: guide_app_display_defaults_central
string-array.item: Sets the default scale for apps opened by the window service on the central display.
Central display uses 200 DPI for apps

string-array.name: guide_app_display_defaults_secondary
string-array.item: Sets the default scale for apps opened by the window service on the second display. It can be turned off for that display.
Second display uses 190 DPI for apps

string-array.name: guide_app_pair_left
string-array.item: Chooses the app that opens on the left when you launch the pair.

string-array.name: guide_app_pair_right
string-array.item: Chooses the app that opens on the right when you launch the pair.

string-array.name: guide_app_pair_proportion
string-array.item: Sets how the two apps share the available width.

string-array.name: guide_app_pair_name
string-array.item: Gives the pair a name for its list entry and shortcut. Leaving it empty uses the app names.

string-array.name: guide_app_pair_dock
string-array.item: Adds a shortcut for this pair to the Controls dock.

string-array.name: guide_button_service_enable
string-array.item: Opens Android accessibility settings so you can enable the service that receives supported hardware button presses.
Controls does not receive key presses

string-array.name: guide_ui_53
string-array.item: Waits for a hardware button press and fills in the code and input device it detected.

string-array.name: guide_ui_54
string-array.item: Starts a binding from a known Android key code you type yourself.

string-array.name: guide_ui_59
string-array.item: Opens the hold threshold and debounce settings for hardware buttons.

string-array.name: guide_ui_62
string-array.item: Clears the saved Android hardware key assignments after confirmation.

string-array.name: guide_cockpit_dictionary_english
string-array.item: Applies the built-in English dictionary to supported factory labels.

string-array.name: guide_cockpit_dictionary_kazakh
string-array.item: Applies the built-in Kazakh dictionary to supported factory labels.

string-array.name: guide_translation_disable
string-array.item: Turns off the factory text dictionary and shows the original labels.

string-array.name: guide_translation_restore
string-array.item: Restores the factory text dictionary used before the last change, if a previous dictionary was saved.

string-array.name: guide_diagnostics_problems_only
string-array.item: Filters the diagnostic view to warnings and errors without changing the saved log.

string-array.name: guide_comfort_playback_door
string-array.item: Pauses supported playback when the driver’s door opens, if media controls are available.
Music continues with the door open
Music pauses when the door opens

string-array.name: guide_comfort_playback_wake
string-array.item: Pauses eligible playback at sleep and can resume the same session at wake.

string-array.name: guide_comfort_brightness_enabled
string-array.item: Adjusts the brightness of the Controls window from the ambient light sensor when this head unit supports it.

string-array.name: guide_comfort_brightness_low
string-array.item: Sets the brightness used for the Controls window in a dark cabin when adaptive brightness is enabled.

string-array.name: guide_comfort_brightness_high
string-array.item: Sets the brightness used for the Controls window in bright light when adaptive brightness is enabled.

string-array.name: guide_trip_gps_title
string-array.item: Adds a GPS track to the active trip when location permission is granted and readings are available.

string-array.name: guide_trips_automatic
string-array.item: Lets Controls start recording after it detects movement or a driving gear on a supported head unit.
Trip starts when driving is detected

string-array.name: guide_trip_permissions
string-array.item: Opens the vehicle reading access flow. Supported readings can appear after access is granted.

string-array.name: guide_rules_extra_conditions
string-array.item: Adds extra checks to a rule. All configured conditions must match before it can run.
Additional light condition blocks the rule

string-array.name: guide_rules_light
string-array.item: Requires an ambient light reading at or beyond the chosen limit. A missing reading does not match.

string-array.name: guide_rules_charge
string-array.item: Requires the traction battery charge to meet the chosen limit before the rule can run.

string-array.name: guide_rules_temperature
string-array.item: Checks the outside temperature against the chosen limit before running the rule.

string-array.name: guide_rules_driving_mode
string-array.item: Requires the confirmed driving mode to match the one selected in the rule.

string-array.name: guide_routine_voice_phrase
string-array.item: Lets you run this saved routine by saying a chosen phrase to the Controls voice assistant.

string-array.name: guide_routine_steps_title
string-array.item: Adds optional steps to a routine. Steps run in the order shown.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_clock
string-array.item: Shows the clock on this desktop. Choose its width or hide it.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_service
string-array.item: Shows the next scheduled service on this desktop. Choose its width or hide it.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_media
string-array.item: Sets how much grid space the desktop media card takes. You can also hide it.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_headlights
string-array.item: Shows supported headlight readings on the desktop. Choose the card width or hide it.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_phone
string-array.item: Places your phone favorites on this desktop. Choose the card width or hide it.

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_route
string-array.item: Places turn guidance on this desktop when navigation data is available.

string-array.name: guide_comfort_power_hold
string-array.item: Places the power hold controls on this desktop. Availability depends on the head unit.

string-array.name: guide_comfort_car_wash
string-array.item: Places the car wash mode controls on this desktop. Availability depends on the head unit.

string-array.name: guide_factory_radio_card
string-array.item: Places the supported factory radio card on this desktop. Choose its width or hide it.

string-array.name: guide_trip_current
string-array.item: Places the current trip duration and distance on this desktop when a trip is active.

string-array.name: guide_trip_levels
string-array.item: Places available charge and fuel readings on this desktop.

string-array.name: guide_trip_usage_last
string-array.item: Places the available consumption figures for the last trip on this desktop.

string-array.name: guide_trip_tyres
string-array.item: Places the available tyre pressure readings on this desktop.

string-array.name: guide_trip_odometer
string-array.item: Places the vehicle’s total mileage on this desktop when the odometer reading is available.

string-array.name: guide_trip_suspension
string-array.item: Places the reported ride height on this desktop when the head unit provides it.

string-array.name: guide_rules_limit_hours
string-array.item: Lets the rule run only in its own daily time window, even if the other conditions match.
Rule is eligible only in its time window

string-array.name: guide_rules_time_start
string-array.item: Sets the start of the daily time window for the rule.
Rule may run from the start time

string-array.name: guide_rules_time_end
string-array.item: Sets the end of the rule’s daily time window.
Rule may run inside the window
Rule waits for the next window

string-array.name: guide_ui_188
string-array.item: Chooses the app launched for this voice command. The same phrase can open a different app after you change the assignment.
The same phrase opens the new app

string-array.name: guide_desktop_info_phone_add
string-array.item: Adds a saved contact to this desktop’s phone favorites so it appears on the card.

string-array.name: guide_app_icon_reset
string-array.item: Restores the app’s original launcher icon in the grid.

string-array.name: guide_app_window_restore
string-array.item: Resets this app’s saved window width, scale and panel margin to their defaults.
